name: smwsprites-baby-yoshi
title: Baby Yoshi
description:
Disassembly of Baby Yoshi + added options for customization and glitch fixing.

Everything is explained in asm and text file included.

Make sure the extra property byte 2 is set to 80 (already like that in the json included).

Leave all the extra bytes to 00 for a vanilla green Baby Yoshi. First extra byte is the palette, check the files or in LM for options.
